object.attr: derived: failure analysis CF-G47 (D-G22). MELLON-GUI-SRS-130 covers text; a faint mark makes a suspect or broken link read as OK. 3:1 is WCAG 2.1 success criterion 1.4.11 for graphical objects. Telling the marks apart by shape is TRACE's (MELLON-TRACE-SRS-85, -87).
object.description: In each theme, the GUI shall draw each link-state mark, each banner and the failed-to-load marking with a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against the adjacent colours.
